additional_info.body:
Hello,
on 19/10/2025 a Client tried to charge with POS during 6:30/6:45 and 7:00/7:30 PM (CU time) on charger n. 314015297001 and couldn't charge.
The Client said that 2 authorization were token from the Credit Card but we don't find any charge (even at 0).
Is it possible to check logs?
Thank you in advance.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0458477-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/SD314015297001] CU logs check CRM:03056000348
additional_info.body:
Buon pomeriggio Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0458477
for charger
Y2/SD 314015297001.
The ticket has been opened for failed authentication via POS on 19.10.2025.
I had a look at the logs to seek for the failed transactions via POS. Unfortunately, being the IM30 PAX terminal integrated in our Sicharge D as a Cloud Payment terminal, from Sicharge D side we do not have visibility at all of the Payment process and authorization.
The communication sequence: POS  --> Fortech --> NTT Data Backend --> Sicharge D (via OCPP). Therefore, from charger side, we only receive a RemoteStartTransaction when the authorization and payment process is successful and communicated from the Backend to the charger. We do not have visibility of any failed payment, as all this communication is limited between the POS and Fortech.
I hope I provided you a clarification in regards of this payment process, hence failed authorization.
If further details on the failed attempts are required, it is necessary to reach out to Fortech directly.
Please let me know if further support is required from our side. Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
